comparison.objective: File a steel block flat to a scribed line and return the file; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual filing strokes, even pressure, material-removal control, and stopping at depth versus driver/wrench seating and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Requires removal to 0.2 mm of the line, flatness within 0.15 mm, no overcut, and tool return; candidate requires a retained angular setting and functional cycling.
comparison.reason: Both demand force control, but filing to a dimensional surface is materially different from locking and validating a threaded angular stop.
